ModMetaData.name: Colony Promises
ModMetaData.author: Lanoz
ModMetaData.description: Colonists request a private bedroom or an improvement, actual recreation, or better copies of equipped gear after persistent unmet needs. Accept a request as a timed promise, decline it, or leave it unanswered. Track leadership trust, progress and outcomes. No DLC required. Deadlines keep running during illness, combat and caravans. Requires Harmony.
